act.text: Dear Hazel, Thank you for coming in yesterday and for the figures. As promised, here are the bridge facility requirements in writing. Documents: (1) completed mandate form, (2) board resolution authorising the facility, (3) photo ID for signatories — to wenlow.mandates@northernmutual.example by Wednesday 15 April, subject 'Calder Systems — mandate'. Decision route: branch assessment, then credit committee sign-off; I expect to be able to give you a decision within two working days of receiving the full pack. Timetable: pack by Wednesday, cash flow by Friday morning, decision by the following Tuesday at the latest. Please treat this as requirements only, not a commitment. Kind regards, Sian Bevan, Manager, Northern Mutual Bank, Wenlow.
